## Core rule

Observed system state outranks AI assumptions.

Documentation does not equal implementation. Implementation does not equal verification. Verification requires evidence.

## Security

Never store or expose secrets. Do not exfiltrate project/system data. High-risk and destructive operations require explicit human authorization.
